title: UX research methods and evidence
summary: UX research methods and evidence operational rules curated for Zanker. Independent synthesis; consult primary sources for exact normative requirements.

rules.title: Specific research questions
rules.intent: Pick research method based on concrete uncertainty
principles: Pick research method based on concrete uncertainty
acceptance: Question, method and sample limitations are documented

rules.title: Qualitative and quantitative balance
rules.intent: Combine observed behavior with quantitative signals where possible
principles: Combine observed behavior with quantitative signals where possible
acceptance: Findings distinguish what happened from why

rules.title: Task-focused usability testing
rules.intent: Evaluate realistic task success and friction
principles: Evaluate realistic task success and friction
antiPatterns: Asking only whether users like a design
acceptance: Task, failure criteria and observations exist

rules.title: Sampling bias awareness
rules.intent: State who participated and who did not
principles: State who participated and who did not
antiPatterns: Presenting tiny convenience samples as representative

rules.title: Inclusive research
rules.intent: Include users with relevant accessibility needs and devices
principles: Include users with relevant accessibility needs and devices
antiPatterns: Testing only with developers on fast desktops

rules.title: Research provenance
rules.intent: Keep date, source, participant consent and evidence references
principles: Keep date, source, participant consent and evidence references
acceptance: Every finding has a provenance record
